title: ClickHouse cluster bring-up + cold-rebuild (the demo verb showcase)
description: The cluster-level demo (per feedback_demo_discipline): the from-zero bring-up of the 9-node ClickHouse cluster + the cold-rebuild gate. Also the `nexus demo` verb showcase -- once the ClickHouseAdapter lands, `nexus demo run demo-0.G.5-clickhouse-*` executes the per-verb specs. Cross-env order: foundation (dhcp+DNS+NFS) -> security (PKI+AppRoles+KV) -> packer build x2 -> analytics-clickhouse apply -> smoke.

steps.command: cd nexus-infra-vmware && pwsh -File scripts/foundation.ps1 apply && pwsh -File scripts/security.ps1 apply

observe.what: foundation writes the 9 dhcp-host reservations + clickhouse.nexus.lab round-robin + the /srv/nfs/analytics-backups export; security writes the clickhouse-server PKI role + 9 AppRole sidecars + the admin/app KV seeds
9 per-host sidecars present (the analytics-clickhouse env reads these at plan time)

steps.command: cd nexus-infra-analytics && (cd packer/analytics-clickhouse-keeper-node && packer init . && packer build .) && (cd packer/analytics-clickhouse-server-node && packer init . && packer build .)

observe.what: two .vmx templates built (clickhouse-keeper / clickhouse-server + clickhouse-client baked, nexus-* units DISABLED, apt units masked)

9 clones -> firstboot -> nftables -> vault-agents -> tls -> keeper-config (RAFT quorum) -> server-config (remote_servers+macros+secure-zookeeper) -> schema-bootstrap (ON CLUSTER DDL + RBAC + fan-out/convergence proof) -> backup-repo (NFS + cross-node BACKUP/RESTORE)
every section GREEN: identity, vault-agent, mTLS (PKCS#8 + round-robin SAN), Keeper quorum, system.clusters (3x2), Distributed fan-out (600), replica convergence, RBAC, round-robin DNS, backup mount

whatProves: the 9-node ClickHouse cluster builds from absolute zero (foundation -> security -> packer -> apply -> smoke) and is genuinely sharded AND replicated, mTLS-everywhere, Keeper-coordinated, and backup-capable. The cold-rebuild gate (destroy -> build -> apply -> smoke ALL GREEN) is the phase-0.G.5 exit criterion.
